content: तोरणः, -णम् [तुर्-युच् आधारे ल्युट् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 An arched doorway, a portal. .²2 An outer door or gateway; गणो नृपाणामथ तोरणाद् बहिः <ls>Śi. 12. 1</ls>; दूराल्लक्ष्यं सुरपतिधनुश्चारुणा तोरणेन <ls>Me. 77</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>). .²3 Any temporary and ornamental arch; भासोज्ज्वलत्काञ्चनतोरणानां स्थानान्तरं स्वर्ग इवावभासे <ls>Ku. 7. 3</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 41</ls>, <ls n="R.">7. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 5</ls>. .²4 An elevated place near a bathing-place. .²5 A triangle supporting a large balance. .{@-णम्@} The neck, throat. .{@-णः@} <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva.
